definition: a relaxed state with no pain
description: Three people take a seat, one after another. A young man perches on a hard white kitchen chair, frowning and shifting about as he talks. A woman in a blue shirt sits up straight on a wooden dining chair with a thin cushion, hands in her lap, and smiles politely at the camera. Then a bearded man drops into a huge padded green armchair, sinks back into the cushions with his arms along the arms of the chair, closes his eyes and lets out a long sigh of relief.

taps.target: the man in the white T-shirt
